title: What Will Remain at the End? (Hard Version)
statement: An array of n cells holding arbitrary integers up to 1e9 in absolute value evolves through q versions under range operations that assign a constant, negate a range, or clamp a range to zero from below. Each query names a cell and asks for the maximum sum of a non-empty contiguous block of that cell's values over all earlier versions; the encoding by the previous answer forces online answers.
